## Objective
- Refine the Haven city-builder in `index.html` with mobile pinch-to-zoom, less clipped content, and working road removal.

## Requirements
- Support two-finger pinch zoom while retaining single-pointer pan and tile selection.
- Fix layout clipping on mobile and desktop.
- Make roads removable through bulldozer mode and the selection-panel demolish action.

## Decisions
- Handle demolition before looking up construction items in `put()`, so bulldozing does not fail when no bulldozer item exists.
- Track active pointers to distinguish pinch gestures from pan and tile selection.
- Adjust grid sizing and mobile/short-screen layout rules to reduce cutoff.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed `put('bulldoze', ...)` so occupied tiles, including roads, can be removed with a 50% refund.
- Added two-pointer pinch zoom while retaining single-pointer pan and tile selection.
- Added responsive sizing and safe-area/layout adjustments in `index.html`.
- JavaScript syntax check and `git diff --check` passed.

## Next Move
1. Run browser-based checks for pinch zoom, road demolition, and selection-panel demolition.
2. Inspect mobile and desktop layouts, especially short screens, and adjust `index.html` if content remains clipped.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: game implementation and all current changes.

- Changes are uncommitted.
- Existing repo files were untracked in the last `git status`; avoid assuming they are part of this task.
